contradictions.source: 為道者已聞道者也已聞道而為之不得不無為而已
contradictions.english: One who practices the Way has already heard the Way. Having heard the Way, one has to do nothing but non-action.
contradictions.why: The English translates '為道者' (one who practices the Way) as 'One who practices the Way', but the source text defines '為道' as the act of practicing the Way, not the person.
